tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

<cung zad bsdus pa/> oṃ swā sti/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'od gsal bde chen rdo rje'i thugs/ /gnyis med ye shes dag pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /zung 'jug gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la/ /rtag par dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di yi dkyil 'khor cho ga ni/ /sngags rig kun gyis yang yang mdzad/ /'on kyang mos pa gtsor gyur pas// 'bri ba 'di la skyon yod min/ /'di ltar ste/ sa chog dang*/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi zhag gi cho ga dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni dbang chog chen mor shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la spyir lhag gnas bzhi yod kyang*/ slob ma lhag gnas 'og tu bshad na lag len bde bas/ 'dir bdag bskyed sngon tu 'gro ba'i/ sa'i lha mo lhag gnas dang*/ lha lhag gnas dang*/ bum pa lhag gnas dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni lhag gnas ky-i sa gzhir dri bzang gi thig le bya/ sa'i lha mo'i mchod gtor dang*/ spyi mchod rnams bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad ā kār+ṣā ya dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ in+d+ra ya/ ag+na ye/ ya ma ya/ ne ri t+ya/ wā ya we/ ku be ra yā/ i shā na ya/ ur+dhaṃ pra h+ma/ sur+ya gra ha a dhi pa ti tsan+d+ra na k+ṣa tra/ a dhi pa ti/ a dho pri thi wī de wī bh+yaḥ a su ra bh+yaḥ na ga bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twata/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum/

oṃ sarba bhu te bh+yoḥ.ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sa la rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang*/ /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar nus par nyer spyod na/ /khyod kyis bar chad mi byed par// dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /sa'i phyogs 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyogs bcur bzhugs te bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyang zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par songs shig ces mtshams rngam dang*/ rol mo'i sgrar bcas pas gtor ma gtong ngo*/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ gnas khang bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rgyan dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ a las byung ba'i nas/ rol mo byin 'bebs kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar ro/ /de nas gtor ma ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs sgom/ de nas sa lha'i mchod gtor rnams/ bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan mang du brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ sa lha'i tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ paṃ las byung ba sa'i lha mo ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ zhi zhing dges la/ rgyan dang na bza' ser po can du gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba la hūṃ gsum/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyis phyag rgya sa la reg ste/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gnang ba byin par bsams/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ gnyis pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi sar dri bzang gis byugs/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ lha gzhan gyi gnas su zlum po bkod/ de rnams kyi steng du me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu bya/ lha re re la sgos mchod bcu bcu las mi nyung bar bshams/ de rnams lag len mthong pas shes/ shar gyi g.yon du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bshams spyi mchod kyang kha gso/

mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje sa gzhi rwa gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su/ thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang zhes pa nas/ gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ lha'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ maṃ bruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ tāṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan steng du/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ de'i pang du yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ le tshe brgyad las shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po nas/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du lho ru rin 'byung sogs rigs bzhi bskyed/ shar lho spyan ma dkar mo sogs yum bzhi bskyed/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma drug bskyed/ de thams cad kyang nas/ nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /shar sgor gshin rje mthar byed sogs khro bo bzhi bskyed nas/ khro bo bzhi po nas bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa'/ lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ bigh+nān ta krita hoḥ zhes pa'i bar gyis ye shes pa stim/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ dang*/ 'khor lo'i 'od kyis 'phro 'du las/ sa snying dkar po zhes pa nas/ kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ / sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur pa'i mchod bstod bya/ gtor chog ltar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul lo/ /gsum pa ni/ bum pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ nang rdzas dang*/ 'cha' tshul dang mchod gtor rnams ni spyi dang 'dra/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/

nang snying po thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ oṃ tap+te tap+te mahā tap+te swāhā/ lha'i chu bo dal gyis 'bab pas yongs su gang ba rnams su gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan bcu dgu/ so sor nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa de rnams kyi steng du/ maṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ tāṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas g.yon rkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar/ lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin no/ / las bum du pad nyi la hūṃ las bgegs mthar byed nag po nas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ sogs skye mched byin rlabs dang*/ lha rnams kyi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su nas/ oṃ dkar po 'i bar gyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ / rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu bgegs mthar byed dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ya mān nas hoḥ yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nas/ rang rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan gyi bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi sgrub chen bzhin no/ / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka hūṃ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun bdun gyis dung chos kyi chu bdud rtsir mos/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste gtso bo la brgya phrag gnyis sogs dang gzhan rnams la nyi shu rtsa gcig re/ las bum la snying po brgya rtsa dang 'phreng sngags ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de las hūṃ lan bdun gyi dung chos gyi chu dang*/ bgegs mthar byed kyi snying po lan bdun bzlas pa'i me tog gsum bum par blug mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyi mchod dang de nyid lnga pas bstod/

so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ ku shas las bum gyi chu blangs nas bum pa rnams la bskor zhing gsang gtor byas nas/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod ces bya/ de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul te sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /yig brgya lan mang du brjod pa'i rjes su bum pa la rdo rjes reg ste slar yang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / sogs kyis bstod/ bum nang gi lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ bzhi pa ni/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ lce hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hā/ spos phor dang dril bu thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ / lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan snga rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /'jam dpal 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba mi shes dag pa'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'bri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas rnams la/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad ni/ /byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/

bstod pa shin tu bsdus pa dgos pa'i rigs la/ dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs sogs/ sho lo ka gcig gi mthar/ phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /rnam dag ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /zab gsal bcu dgu'i lha tshogs rnams/ /'khor dang bcas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes pa 'dis bstod/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol ba thams cad phyogs bcings par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ re zhig mi 'degs par zhag de nyid kyi nub mo mchod pa rgyun mi chad par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor gyi zhag gi cho ga la dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ mchod pa gsum mo/ /dang po la/ ye shes kyi thig gi cho ga las thig gi cho ga rdul tshon byin gyis rlabs pa dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ tshon skud sna lnga la yungs kar gyi phye ma dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga la/ bsres pas byugs/ dri zhim pos bgos la/ nag dkar ser dmar ljang khu lnga rim pas mthe bong sogs kyi rtsa bar bkod nas cung zad bskyangs te/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i thig skud nag po/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ bruṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dkar po rnam snang gi ngo bo/ oṃ las byung ba'i thig skud ser po rin 'byung gi ngo bo/ dz+riṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dmar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ khaṃ las byung ba'i thig skud ljang khu/ don grub kyi ngo bo rnams ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs kar hūṃ bruṃ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi srad bu 'od kyi rang bzhin du bzhugs/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ badz+ra sū draṃ me pra yats+tsha mahā maṇ+ḍal sū dra ṇā ya hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ de bzhin du ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ gnas su/ sha shwa ta

dang*/ rat+na saṃ bha wa dang*/ a mi ta bha dang*/ a mo gha sid+dhi zhes pa rnams bcug ste gsol ba btab/ rang gi mig gnyis su dzaḥ las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer ser po can/ mig 'bras hūṃ/ oṃ dīp+ta driṣ+tī aṅku sha dzaḥ nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu rigs lnga rnams spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ de nas slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje mar gsal ba dang lhan cig thig skud brkyangs te/ oṃ a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā pa ra spa ra a nu pra briṣ+ta sarba dharma ar+yan+ta a nu briṣ+ta sarba dharmā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes dang po so sor sgril/ de nas phyogs gcig tu sgril lo/ /de nyid snod gtsang mar bzhag la/ rang gi mig g.yon pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yas pa ṭa las zla ba/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ta ma ṭa/ thig skud la drag tu bltas pas brtan par byas la/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ dri bzang gi chus gtor/ lag pas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra hūṃ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ /las thams cad pas bsrung ba byas nas bzhag go /lhag gnas kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa gsar du bshams/ sgrub thabs bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang nang mchod phul nas/

oṃ badz+ra udhiṣ+ṭha zhes pa'i sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor btegs la nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su bzhugs par gyur/ de nas mchod bstod bsdus pa dang las thams cad pas bsrung ba bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ/ zhes dri bzang gi chus gtor byi dor bya mtha' la me tog bkram/ slob dpon shar du phyogs pas lte bar lag pa g.yon pas thig skud bzung*/ slob ma nub tu phyogs pa la g.yas pas thig sna gtad/ dz+dzeḥ zhes brjod slob mas g.yon pas blangs la lte bar bzung*/ de nas ji ltar thig gdab pa ni/ thig 'dzin tshul de nyid las/ slob dpon gyi g.yas pa'i theb mdzug gis thig skud nam mkhar 'debs pa'i tshe/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ hūṃ/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi/ /dus yin de ring 'dir spyon cig /thig gi sgras/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul te mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon nas thig skud la thim/ de yang nub shar gnas pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ lho byang gnyis pa me dbang shar gyi logs/ /rlung srin nub dang rlung dbang byang yin te/ /mi srin gnas pas lho yi rtsa thig gdab// srin dbang zur thig dang po me rlung gnas/ /zur thig gnyis pa btab de thig chen brgyad/ /ces pa ltar la g.yas bskor dang rgyab 'gros sogs lag len bzhin bya/ de dag tu slob dpon rkang pa g.yon skyil krung dang g.yas rkang mthil sa la btsugs pa'i tsog pu dang*/ slob ma de las ldog pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ thig skud de nyid dam gzhan yin na/ bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las bgegs mthar byed/ las bum gyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ sa lha'i skabs bzhin byas la/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma ho/

zhes pas ye shes kyi thig bteg ste/ thig sna gtod tshul sogs ye theg dang 'dra bar byas nas las thig gdab par bya'o/ /tshangs dang zur thig legs btab nas/ cha chen bcu drug bgo bar bya'o/ /dang drug phyed gdab phyi phyed gdab/ gnyis bdun bzhi cha bzhi ru bgo /gsum pa bzhi pa rang sar bzhag /lnga brgyad dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /dgu po rtsa ba'i thig yin te/ /bco lnga pa ni mda' yab thig /de gnyis zur nas zur du'o/ /bcu pa la sogs thig lnga ni/ /zur thig nas brtsam tshangs thig ngos/ /gnyis par reg pa dang po gnyis/ /bdun par reg pa phyi ma gsum/ /tshangs thig nas brtsam gnyis pa ni/ /bcu nas bcu gcig bar du'o/ / tshangs thig nas brtsam dang po ni/ /dgu nas bcu gnyis la reg pa'o/ /de nas dngos su gsum pa'i bar/ /steng du bcu gsum pa la reg /de gnyis rtse sbrel bzhi pa ni/ /bcu gcig pa nas bcu bzhi'i bar/ /rtse nas rtse ru bcu bzhi pa/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams lnga pa dang*/ /drug pa bdun rnams bcu gcig nas/ /bco lnga'i thig la reg par gdab/ /mda' phyir gcig nas tshangs thig steng*/ /cha chung gnyis kyi steng du bskor/ /g.yas g.yon sne las 'thud nas ni/ /cha chung re res g.yas g.yon bskor/ /de nang cha chung phyed kyis bskor/ /nang gi bskor thig la reg par/ /bcu drug la sogs thig bzhi ni/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams bdun pa dang*/ /drug lnga bzhi la reg par gdab/ /de dag rnams kyi rtse mo'ang sbrel/ /nyi shu la sogs thig gsum ni/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams dang po la/ / reg pa tsam du gdab bar bya/ /yang na rtsa ba cha chung gnyis/ /rtse mo cha chung gcig dbus rwa/ /tshangs phyir gnyis dang mda' phyir gcig /ka rgyan rtse nas nang rwa bskor/ /de nas ngos gnyis steng du gcig /phyi nas snga ma'i tshad kyis bskor/ /dbus kyi cha gsum bzhi bzhir bgo /bcu gnyis bcu gcig bcu steng bskor/ /gsum pa bzhi pa bsnol mar btab/ /le tshe dgu par 'gyur ba yin/

/phyi rol rim pas bskor thig bzhi/ /gcig phyed gcig gi tshad nas bskor/ /zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ tshon sna lnga'am/ nyi shu rtsa lnga legs pa bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs/ thig skud ces pa'i gnas su rdul tshon zhes pa dang / badz+ra sū traṃ zhes pa'i gnas su badz+ra tsi traṃ dang*/ sū tra ṇā yi gnas su tsi tra ṇā ya zhes pa'i khyad par ma gtogs ye thig dang 'dra la/ mig g.yas pa la zhes pa nas/ brtan par byas kyi bar yang rdul tshon zhes pa nyid khyad par ro/ / oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla zhing mtheb srin gyis mnye/ rdul tshon rnams la hiḥyig bris te/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul mang zhing*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la chags pa dang*/ rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig ces brjod la yid kyis mchod/ bzhi pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hoḥ zhes pas las thig kyang btegs la/ slob dpon nang du zhugs te/ hiḥhiḥ zhes rdo rje'i lta ba dang bcas sgo'i thad kyi rtsa thig dbye'o/ /gal te las thig la bskyed chog med par cha dbye ba tsam yin na 'degs mi dgos so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dbus kyi phur bu phyung*/ ye shes pa lag pa'i rdo rje la thim/ phur khung rtsig pa'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i rdul tshon gyis 'gengs bzhin du dril bu dkrol la/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid 'jam dbyangs rgyal po ste// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang na yang dag gnas/ / zhes pa'i don dran bzhin du glu blang ngo*/ /de nas ci bder 'gyed de/ dkyil 'khor gyi cha thams cad kyi kha dog dang mtshan ma ni spyi dang 'dra la/ bum pa brgyad kyang 'bri/ le tshe dgu'i dbus ma sngo ba/ gzhan rnams phyogs mdog dang*/ ka ba nag po rang rang gi mtshan ma can/

gdung zlum nag po la rdo rje dkar po'i 'phreng ba'o/ /lha mtshan bskyed chog las shes shing*/ gling rgyab phyogs mdog dang sngon po gnyis kar 'gal lo/ /mchod bstod byas te rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ de ltar 'bri ba'i bya ba zin pa na/ spyi dang mthun par bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ las bum gyis khrus gsol rnams byas la/ las thams cad pa bzlas shing bsrung*/ rgyan dang mchod rdzas kun la 'di las thams cad pas bsang gtor byas nas sa rgyan gnam rgyan rnams bkram/ mchod pa yang sta gon gyi dus las mi nyung ba nges par bsham dgos shing mang ba la ni tshad med de/ bum pa yang shar sgo'i g.yon du 'god/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis kyang bsham mo/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa nyer bsdu'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la 'jug go /de yang dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'og tu oṃ las byung ba'i nas/ 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ de'i dbus su saṃ las rdo rje dkar po nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams sa bon dang phyag mtshan dang sku yongs rdzogs su gyur pa ni/ dbus su maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ shar du bruṃ las 'khor lo bruṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ lho ru aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan sogs/ nub tu dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med sogs/ byang du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las don yod grub pa sogs/ shar lhor laṃ las 'khor lo laṃ gyis mtshan pa las spyan ma sogs/ lho nub tu maṃ las ut+pal dmar po maṃ gyis mtshan pa las mā ma kī

sogs/ nub byang du paṃ las pad+ma dmar po paṃ gyis mtshan pa las gos dkar mo sogs/ byang shar du tāṃ las ut+pal ser po tāṃ gis mtshan pa las sgrol ma sogs/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ dzaḥlas me long dmar po dzaḥs mtshan pa las gzugs rdo rje sogs/ lho nub tu hūṃ las pi waṃ sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las sgra rdo rje ma sogs/ nub byang du baṃ las dri bzang ser pos gang ba'i dung chos baṃ gyis mtshan pa las dri rdo rje ma sogs/ byang shar du hoḥlas ro drug gis gang ba'i snod dmar po hoḥs mtshan pa las ro rdo rje ma sogs/ shar sgo'i g.yas su khaṃ las lha rdzas kyi gos kha dog sna tshogs pa khaṃ gis mtshan pa las reg rdo rje ma sogs/ shar sgo'i g.yon du raṃ las chos 'byung dkar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa las chos dbyings rdo rje ma sogs/ de thams cad kyang nas/ nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /shar sgor hūṃ las rdo rje tho ba rwa nyi shu pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las gshin rje mthar byed sogs/ lho sgor hūṃ las rdo rje mtshan pa'i be con dkar po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las shes rab mthar byed sogs/ nub sgor hūṃ las pad+ma dmar po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las pad+ma mthar byed sogs/ byang sgor hūṃ las rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las bgegs mthar byed sogs/ khro bo bzhi po nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ /bdag nyid dang dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi pang du sme sha can gyi rigs las byung ba'i bu mo ut+pal mthing kha lta bu'i mdog can lo bcu drug lon pa gzugs dang mdangs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas gnas par gyur/ de nyid kyang maṃ yig dmar ser du gyur/ maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa las yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ rdzogs par gyur/ yum gyis spyi gtsug nas snying kha'i bar du nas/ at+ma ko3haṃ/ de ltar rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rang rang gi lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs shing gcig tu 'dus pa rnams bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub sems su zhu ba rdo rje lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par grub par gyur/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mkha' nas nang phyir spros/ oṃ ya mān+ta krita dzaḥ nas/ hoḥ lha thams cad mig tu nas/ rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ /lha thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi nas/ rdo rje gsum gyis sngags brjod zin pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin bya'o/ /yab yum gnyis ka'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du nas/ yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang*/ rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ bdag pos dbu brgyan gyi bar sgrub pa chen po bzhin no/ / dbang gi lha thams cad kyang gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ sems dpa' gsum rtsegs gi skabs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs zhes pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum ser sngo dkar zhes sogs 'don pa sgyur dgos/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ nas/ ta kṛta hoḥ 'i bar bsnyen pa chen po'i skabs bzhin no/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni sgrub thabs bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin stsol/

/oṃ mañdzu badz+ra de wa tsakra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra āḥhri pra wa ra sad ka rār+thaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du 'don pa spos la/ yon chab zhes pa'i tshab tu/ zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ zhes pa ni/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ lha yi me tog dam pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyis par 'tshal/ / thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig / de bzhin du/ bdug spos/ nghu pe/ snang gsal/ ā lo ke dri mchog gan+dhe/ zhal zas/ nai be d+ya/ rol mo/ shap+ta/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /mchod par byed pas mchod par bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi/ / 'bul sngags gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la/ rū pa zhes 'don pa spo/ sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /bdag gi rigs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod pa yi tshul bsnyes pa'o/ /shap+ta/ dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gtso/ /gan+dhe/ ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /rā sa/ reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid sangs rgyas sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /spar+sha/ gzugs sgra ro la sogs pa la/ /rtag tu sems ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i snying po btus pa'o/ /dharma dhā tu/ zhing 'dir 'khor lo rin chen gyi/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin rer bdag gis dbul bar bgy-i/ /tsakra rat+na/ zhing 'di nor bu rin chen gyi/ / sogs/ ma ṇi rat+na/ btsun mo/ s+t+rī rat+na/ blon po/ pu ru ṣa rat+na/ glang po/ hāsti rat+na/ rta mchog a shwa rat+na/ khyim bdag gṛ ha pa te rat+na/

de nas nang mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ dpal ldan rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*/ 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes mar me mdzad bzang po/ /'jam dpal grags pa bde ba chen po yi ge pa/ /kar+ṇa pa dang dzñā na shrī mi tra dang*/ /ba liṃ ā tsar+ya dang gnyos lo yon tan grags/ /rdo rje bla ma jo sras dpal seng grags pa dpal/ /sangs rgyas ras chen byang ngar bsod nams rgyal po dang*/ /bsod nams bla ma 'jam dbyangs rin chen 'byung gnas dang*/ /mkhas btsun ye shes rin chen blo gros bzang*/ /tshul rgyal dar bzang nam mkha' rin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ /dbang rgyud man ngag gsum ldan bla ma rnams la 'bul/ / zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥmañdzu badz+ra maṃ hūṃ/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ sogs so so'i sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud spyod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal tu mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

dgos kyi chos skyong yod na/ de dang de'i snying po'i mthar yi ge 'bru gsum btags la 'bul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang phyogs skyong bcu lha chen po brgyad klu chen po brgyad gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun 'jigs byed chen po dgu rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim par gyur cig bud med gzugs ldan mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa ni/ /dri dang me tog 'phreng brgyan ste/ /yon tan skye rags mā ma kīr/ /shes rab can gyis byin rlabs la/ /'khor lo'i dbus su mchod par bya/ /rin chen 'byung gnas na chung mchog /rin chen sna tshogs mchog gis brgyan/ /dngos grub rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /lha rnams kun la dbul bar bya// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma la/ /'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par zhugs/ / 'pho med bde ba mngon du gyur/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇā badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ thabs shes mnyam par sbyor las byung*/ /byang chub sems sgros de bzhin gshegs/ /ma lus nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /bla med mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ āḥ.a nut+ta ra pū dzi te hūṃ/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar phyung*/

/me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ rnam par rtog pa kun gyi tshogs/ /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /nges par bsreg pa de'i spos/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /dhu pe/ yi ge hūṃ las yang dag byung*// sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /ā lo ke bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*/ /de nyid kyis kyang byug pa ni/ /thugs kyi= /gan+dhe/ 'dir ni gang dag gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i phyir du mchod par bgyi/ /ne we t+ya/ rdo rje pad+mar yang dag bskyod/ /zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung*/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mi shigs sgra/ /thugs kyi= /shap+ta/ rgod dang sgeg dang rtse 'jo sogs/ /sna tshogs kyis ni sems dgar byed/ /rnam par thar ba'i sgo gang dag /thugs kyi=/ mahā su khaṃ/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ mañdzu badz+ra sogs gong bzhin la/ badz+ra wās+t+ra ye/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa ni/ /ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga/ /dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ /me tog kar+ṇi ka ra dang*/ /ma li ka dang yu thi ka /me tog ka ra wi ra dang*/ /lha mo dgu dang nam mkha'i khams// dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon tsam du/ /gru bzhi shin tu mdzes pa la/ /mchod rten rin chen snang bzhi pa/ /gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdag gi lus/ /bla ma bshad dang gci bas mchod/ /mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan pa'i/ khu ba blangs nas mchod par bya/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ /ba dan lda ldi sil snyan sogs/ /rta babs mchog dang bla re dang*/ /bsil yab 'khyams dang khri stan sogs/

/bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam shing*/ /nam mkha' mdzod sogs dbul bar bgyi/ /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ / de nas bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar de nyid lnga pa dang*/ zag bcas phung po gnas gyur zhing*/ /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku/ / kun mkhyen kun mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la 'dud/ / sa sogs 'byung ba rnam dag cing*/ /byams sogs tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /zag med bde ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /gti mug dga' ma sogs phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna la sogs rnam dag cing*/ /phar phyin drug gi ngo bo nyid/ /dkyil 'khor mchod la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rdo rje gzugs sogs phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ba'i thibs po rnam bcom pa/ /bsdu dngos bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang mdzad pa'i/ /sgo bsrung bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing*/ /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can/ /bde chen snying po legs rdzogs pa/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yi/ / sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar la brtson/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rdo rje'i thugs yin srid dang thar gyur gang*/ /zhi zhing sgrib med nam mkha' 'dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas rnam rgyas byang chub dbang phyug rdo rje can/ /de la lus ngag yid kyi rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang*/ /rnam par shes dang skye mched drug dang dbang po drug /sa chu me dang rlung dang nam mkha' thams cad ni/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug nyes pa 'dod chags rdo rje chos bcas gang*/ /rig pa'i sbyor pa las byung rtag tu rab 'brel bar/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dga' bas myos pa'i dngos gyur pa/ /byang chub sems=

/sdud dang dga' dang rnam pa de bzhin mi 'gyur dang*/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin sems su rjes thogs chos/ rmongs dang zhe sdang 'dod chags sgrib pa rdo rje ste/ /byang chub sems 'dra= /gang zhig thog ma med dngos rnam dag 'di sgom pa/ /thabs dang shes rab las byung spros dang rnam par bral/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur rtul zhugs dam tshig sbyor ba rtag /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dngos grub mchog gi thabs ni 'di bsgoms shing*/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga nyer bar sgrub pa bsgrub pa dang*/ /bsgrub pa chen pos blo mi 'gyur ba'i bsgrub dbang po/ /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la= /gang zhig thun bzhi'i rdo rje dang ni sgrub byed pa/ /mi snang la sogs sna tshogs mchog dang dman 'grub cing*/ /bla ma'i drin gyis 'di na ma nor lam rtogs pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig rab gsal 'dus pa'i rgyud ni nyan pa dang*/ /'don par byed dang klog pa dang ni sems pa dang*/ /mchod pa'i byed pa dang ni 'bri 'am 'brir 'jug pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang du zhi sogs las tshogs shin tu brtags pa yi/ /'khrul 'khor sngags kyi cho ga de bzhin rgyas 'debs pa'i/ /bsgrub bya 'di dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa'i dbang po ni/ /byang chub= /gang gis gtso bo sgrub pa pos mthar reg pa dang*/ /legs par dran dang ming tsam nges par thos pa dang*/ /dad par byed cing phyogs cig tsam zhig 'dzin pa dag /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes so/ /de dag gi mthar bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya zhing yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma ni skabs 'dir nges par 'bul zhing de yang gtor ma byin gyis rlabs ma thag mdun bskyed kyi lha la phul bas chog gi gtor ma'i lha spyan 'dren pa mi dgos so/

/dgos kyi chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul na/ yang bar 'dir bya la de nas sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i cho gas phyogs skyong la nang gtor 'bul lo/ /de'i rjes su phyi rol gtor ma gtor te/ gtor ma lcog zlum tshad che zhing sha chang la sogs pa la zas sku bag can gyis sbags pa bden kha dog sna tshogs pa btsugs pa zhig dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du stegs bu'i steng du bzhag chu gsum mam/ gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang nang mchod rdor dril rol cha sogs 'dus byas sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu nas ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ mchod yon dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra yud+dha sogs kyis so sor phul/ oṃ āḥ dus gsum skyes pa kun dang nas/ bsrung ba mdzad du gsol gyi bar gyis spyi btab/ de nas mchod pa rnams gtor snod du bsdus la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ kun 'grub shog / yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ bdag ni rnam g.yeng nas/ bzod par gsol/ /oṃ a kā ro nas/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gtor ma rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtsang sar dor / mtsham rngam dang bcas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags drag tu bzlas te bgegs bskrad do/ / slob dpon gyis rting mnan la 'ongs te nang du nye reg bya/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs te lha snam gyi steng nas bskor ba byas par mos la hūṃ bzhi pa bzla zhing*/ bskor ba lan gsum byas te/ shar sgo nas/ me tog sngon po phul la/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ / skye ba'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥhi hi hi/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol hoḥ yang nub sgo'i thad du song ste/ pad skor las hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bkrol bzhin pas/ oṃ badz+ra uta gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes pas shar sgo phye bar bsam mo/

/de bzhin du sgo bzhi char phye nas/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya mi/ zhes pas me tog phreng ba blangs te/ mgo la bcings/ oṃ pra ṇa ma mi sarba ta thā ga tāṃ/ zhes phyag bya/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir sbyin bsreg gi cho gas lha mnyes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa dbang bskur ba'i bya ba la/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ bsam pa 'chos shing bu ru bya/ /gsol btab mos pa bskyed pa dang*/ /thun mong sdom bzung byin rlabs dang*/ /mchod dang so shing dor ba dang*/ khyor chu ku sha bsrung skud byin/ /spro ba bskyed cing rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar bcu gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can/ / kun de dag la dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga yang dag rjes su gnang*/ kha cig gsang sngags grub don gnyer/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan ni 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ / slar yang dad pa ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer bas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'don mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ / zhes brjod la don sems su bcug gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams me'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba la gnas shing snying khar yang raṃ yig las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis kar 'bar ba las sdig sgrib dang tha mal gyi phung po lhan cig tu bsregs te rnam shes oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum du gnas par gyur/ de nyid slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis bkug zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/

slar yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste rdo rje'i lam nas byung bas dbang bskur zhing mthar gnyis su med par thim/ hūṃ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te gral la rim pa bzhin du 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda' sprad/ gsum pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bzhi pa ni/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin ste/ /bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag bsnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces brjod la don bshad do// lnga pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ / zhes lan gsum mo/ /drug pa ni/ las thams cad pa bzlas pas slob ma la bsrung zhing*/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas kyis slob ma'i snying ga la sogs pa gnas gsum du dri bzang gi chus thig le byed cing 'bru gsum brjod pas/

snying khar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po rnams bsam du bcug yang yas mar reg pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum spyan drangs te bstim la 'bru gsum brjod/ yang mas yar reg pas slob ma'i sgo gsum dang rdo rje gsum dbyer med par gyur par mos so/ /bdun pa ni/ mchod pa rnams las thams cad pas bsangs/ oṃ āḥhū ཾ gis byin gyis brlabs/ me tog spyi bor sbyin pa sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ sogs kyi mthar/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang khyod ldan pas/ /dus rnams kun du bde bar mnos/ / zhes brjod/ brgyad pa ni/ dri bzang gi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi khru gang las mi chung bar byas la/ so shing hūṃ las byung bar mos te/ las thams cad pa bzla bzhin du slob ma'i lag tu gtad slob mas kyang rtse mo nas 'cha' ba'i tshul byas te maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du ltos med du dor/ phyogs bzhir las bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir gter kyi bum pa sogs dang steng du rig 'dzin 'og tu sa 'og sogs 'grub pa dang phyi rol du lhung na grub pa med par bstan to/ /dgu pa ni/ dung chos kyi chu la las thams cad pa lan bdun bzla/ de nas

oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha dharma sarba pā paṃ nish+tsa a s+ya sho dhā ya/ sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes khyor ba bkang te mthung du bcugabacu pa ni/ ku sha bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ dang dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha che ba gtan dang chung ba sngas kyi don du/ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes sbyin/ bcu gcig pa ni/ slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i srad bu dmar po gsum bltab du sgril la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab/ de bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bu slob ma'i bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i mthu can du gyur/ las thams cad pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de kho na bzla bzhin du 'chang ste/ skyes pa la dpung pa g.yon dang bud med la g.yas dang byis pa la mgul du bcing ngo*/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam nang ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ / gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa byed par du mar ni/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smon ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis yang dag bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed cag kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyod rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ / lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/

khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes brjod la don bshad do/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ khyed rnams do nub dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i gnas khang gzhan du yang rung ste ku sha chung ba sngas su bcug che ba stan du bting dug gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs nas lha dang bla ma rjes su dran bzhin pas seng ge'i nyal stangs kyis nyol zhig des dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rmi lam gyi khyad par rnams mthong bar 'gyur bas/ rmi lam ci byung ba thams cad nang par nga la smra dgos so/ /kyai bu dag nyon zhig do nub ni/ /seng ge'i nyal stabs bzhin du nyol/ khyod kyi rmi lam dge mi dge /mthong ba tho rengs bdag la smros// zhes brjod la/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i gsang chus gtor zhing bsrung ba bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ /dam pa bdag la bstsal nas kyang*/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i// gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ / zhes slob dpon gyis dris pa la/ gsang ba nas bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ / zhes lan btab/ de nas sdom pa bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes sgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/

/'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /'di ni rin chen rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom par rtag tu bshad/ /phyi nang theg pa gsang ba gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar bya// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ / de nas sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*/ /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ / pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/

/mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ / byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyid nas/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ / dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum mo/ /gnyis pa dbang dngos gzhi la/ bdag 'jug dang slob ma dbang bskur gnyis las bdag 'jug la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi a laṅka ra wā dra pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūṃ gis smad g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ gis stod g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa hūṃ gis gtsug tor bcing ngo*/ / oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra mā na ya hūṃ gis mig dar bcing*/ las bum gyi chus gtor la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān tā kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ rang skad cig gis rnam snang dkar po dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis lus gsal zhing dag par byas/ kyai khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ / zhes lan gdab/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po gyen du langs pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da ya mi/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying khar gtugs la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlobs par 'gyur gyis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugasapa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/

ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ / zhes gsang bar gdams so/ /de nas oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradzñān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+mata kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛta hūṃ/ zhes sgo ba bzhi'i snying po dang*/ ā khaṃ wi ra hūṃ dang*/ na maḥs man+ta gu ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇī/ oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pa dang*/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags rnams brjod/ dam bzhag rnam pa bzhi ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yi ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyed kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra zhig dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dbang gi ye shes gsang bar gdams pa'i sgo nas dang*/ rdo rje snying khar gtugs la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /bdud rtsi 'bru gsum gyis lce thog tu bzhag /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ badz+ra ud ga ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ rdo rje spyi bor gtugs la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi ngas 'di byos zhes bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so khyodakyi nga la brnyas par ma byed cig byas na khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ de nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig lan gsum/ skad cig gi rang nyid 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug par gsal ba'i snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa la grwa bzhir rdo rje dang dbus su thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūṃ nag po mtshan pa/

mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po la bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su sku rdo rje'i ngo bo ha dkar pos mtshan pa/ rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ long bu gnyis su rdo rje gsum bskul bar byed pa'i sa bon dzhaiḥdamar po me'i rang bzhin can/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyung*/ rlung g.yos me spar dzhaiḥ yig bskul de las 'phros pa'i me'i 'od rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus gang*/ snying kha'i sa bsregs mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan pas chu'i dkyil 'khor las babs pa'i bdud rtsi sa la thim pas/ bde drod 'bar te lus sems mchog tu tshim pa thob hūṃ āḥha'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang gi lus la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥbe sha ya staṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya/ hūṃ āḥha dzhaiḥ zhes drag tu bzlas mthar/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ lan gnyis kyi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag traṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i me tog pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ pra ti grih+na s+t+waṃ/ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ me tog spyi bor byin/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ / ces mig dar bkrol/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/

oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong*/ /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya ho ho hoḥ gnyis pa zhugs nas dbang bskur ba la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyi gsang ngo*/ /de nas dbang dngos la/ chu dbang ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas bum pa'-i chu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa nag po nag dkar dmar ba nas/ pad+ma 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dbang rdzas la mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ bdag dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis ka la gnyis su med par thim/ mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas sogs/ lan gcig dbang bskur ba po'i lha rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas hūṃ zhes gsung bzhin dbang bskur lus thams cad gang bde ba chen po myong dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na dbang lnga la chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas so/

/ zhes brjod/ cod pan gyi dbang ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan ser po nas/ 'dzin pa/ dbang rdzas la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan can/ spyi bor oṃ nas/ thugs kha'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ gnyis ka la gnyis su med par thim/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ byang chub rdo rje sogs/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro bas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbu rgyan mgo la bkon/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ zhes dar dpyangs bcings/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs zhing*/ nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ gong bzhin mchod/

dbang lnga pas cod paṇa gyi dbang nga rgyal dang ser sna/ tshor ba'i/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi/ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dmar po nas 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ 'od dpag med yab yum/ rdo rjer gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyi long*/ /oṃ sarba nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ rdo rje'i dbang*/ 'dod chags/ 'du shes kyi/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'od dpag med kyi/ dril bu'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa ljang khu/ nas/ don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/ don yod grub pa yab yum/ dril bur/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sā ma ya s+t+waṃ/ don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ dril bu'i dbang*/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi/ bya ba grub pa'i don yod grub pa'i/ ming gi dbang ni/ dbang rdzas/ me tog phreng ba'am/ rdo rjer bcas pa'i dril bu/ bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rnam par snang mdzad dkar po nas rnam mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum/ me tog phreng bar gyur zhes sam/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bur gyur zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ badz+ra nā maḥ.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal ch+gai mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes ming dbang bskur zhing*/ rnam snang gis dbu rgyan/ ming gi dbang*/ gti mug dgagazugs kyi chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhes 'don pa spo'o/ / rang la dngos kun gang snang ba/ /de ni gtso chen 'jam dbyangs rgyal/

/gang de'i sangs rgyas ye shes nyid/ /chos kun rang bzhin gyis dag pa'o/ / zhes brjod cing*/ don rgyas par bshad do/ /brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ 'dir dam tshig gsum sbyin pa la byed do/ / dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcing*/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ / lan gsum gsor nas snying khar gtod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skye bu'o/ / dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas dril bu āḥs mtshan pa las kun tu bzang mo dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ de zhu ba las dril bu/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcad/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ / phyogs brgyad du dkrol/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /skad cig gis rang nyid kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang chen po dkar po nas/ rin po ches spras par gyur/ gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gi /gsang sngags ma tshang med par bzlos/ /rang gi rigs pa'i ngo bo de/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum khyab gyur pa/ /rang gi lha'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ / mi bzang dkar thub sdom pa ni/ /rten kyang mi snang mngon shes dang*/ /mkha' spyod sku gsung thugs rnams las/

/byung ba'i dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur/ de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis/ /'gyur med mchog gi chos brnyes so/ /sdug bsngal ma yin bdag bde bas/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams brten/ /gang gzhan dman par bshad pa rnams/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur zhing*/ /ye shes don gnyer chags can gyi/ /sbyor bas sku gsung thugs rnams ni/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ / thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gi thog ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la dngos dang*/ mtha' brten gnyis las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang stegs kyi steng du/ rang sems hūṃ dkar po las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug nas/ rin po ches brgyan pa yid ngag lus gsum rnam par dag pa thugs gsung sku rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa ni snying rje chen po dang stong pa nyid dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid can te byang chub kyi sems so/ /mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ shrī hūṃ/ yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin te chu dbang dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbu rgyan dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang/ / zhes sogs kyis rdo rje dang*/ shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang*/ / mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs byed phyir/ /rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur ro/ / zhes dril bu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi sogs ming gi dbang bskur ro/ /slar yang brtan byed du/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ sbyin par bya/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag par gyur/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa

sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gsum brjod/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyang slob ma'i lus la gnyis su med par thim/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las dbang rtags rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan cing*/ thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dang de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yang grub par gyur/ brtan bzhugs ni/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dor*/ de nas 'di skad ces/ de ring khyod ni dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /rgyud pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ / gnyis pa la/ rjes gnang dang*/ de nyid brjod pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ mig thur gyi rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hri/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ / me long dang po ni/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ / dril bu'i rjes gnang ni/ dril bu 'khrol bzhin pas/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ / mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang ni/ yi ge hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o/ / zhes so/ /de nas me long gnyis pa ni/ a las byung ba'i me long*/

oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ / gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems yin par shes par gyis shig chos bshad kyi rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+ṭe a/ ā deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun tu ma lus gang bar gyis/ / sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ / rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes gnang ni/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / de bzhin du/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ bdag 'jug dang slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs gang yin yang rung ste shin tu sdus pa la dga' bas mig thur nas de yan chad bzhag kyang rung zhing rjes snang 'di dag dbang bzhi pa'i mthar sbyar na'ang legs pa yin no/ /sems can gyi don gyi rjes gnang ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis sems can gang*/ /ji ltar ji ltar 'dul gyur pa/ de lta de ltar sems can don/ /chags sogs dag pas sgrub par gyis/ / zhes so/ /bsgoms shing dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ nyin re bzhin yang dus gsum du/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ /ldan pas thun mong cig shos kyi/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/

/mi snang bar ni stong cig dang*/ /mngon shes ldan pas stong gnyis dang*/ /rig pa 'dzin pas stong gsum dang*/ /rdo rje can gyis 'gro kun bdag /gzhan yang zhi dang rgyas la sogs/ /gang la ci 'dod las rnams ni// 'khor lo rjes gnyis sbyor ba yis/ /sgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa yin la/ lha rnams ni phung po dang khams dbang po yul dang bcas pa dang lta ba bzhi rnam par dag pa/ ye shes lnga dang tshad med bzhi dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang dad sogs bzhi'i ngo bo yin la/ de bzhin du dbang bskur ba dang dngos grub kyi don du dkyil 'khor bri ba dang sgrub pa dang rab tu gnas pa dang sbyin sreg dang dbang bskur dang zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rnams ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar na lus te gzugs brnyan can gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ lus kyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ro/ / dbang gong ma spyi khyab gyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ / srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam spyod pa/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ khyod zhabs mad+mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas gyur pa/ /dmyal ba nas ni gtso bos drongs/ /sdug bsngal thams cad thar mdzad pa'i/ /mgon med bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ / ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas dam tshig sgrags pa ni/ ji ltar dbang bskur tshul las ni/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun thob pa/ /de ltar byang chub spyod pa sogs/ /dge ba'i tshul gsung gzhan gyis min/

/de bas bu khyod dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa rtag tu skyong bar byos/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' zhing*/ /de las gzhan yang dam tshig bsrung*/ /dkon mchog gnod byed gzhom bya ste/ /bud med kun la spyad par bya/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gang bshad pa/ /de yang cho ga bzhin du bsrung*/ / zhes pa la/ de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes lan btab/ rdo rje sems khyod sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba rab tu sgrub pa stai/ /rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' rgya chen sras su gyur pa rnams/ /yun ring stong pa nyid sgoms pas ni rab tu gdungs pa la/ /dga' ba yid 'ong bde ba chen po nyid kyis mnyes par mdzod/ /'dod chags de ni dri med kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa ste/ /dag pa'i rdo rje 'dod chags dam tshig las ni phye mdzad nas/ /dka' ba rnam pa drug po spyod pas shin tu gdungs pa rnams/ /rab tu dges dbang 'dod pa'i bde pa nyid la 'jog par mdzod/ /pad+ma'i dbus nas rin chen 'bar ba rab phyung nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba rnams kyi dbu ni skams pa la/ /rnam dag rdo rje las ni byung pa'i ye shes chu/ /dri ma med pa rin chen spyir dbab dbang bskur gsol/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam 'dod chags tshul dag pas/ /pad+ma'i gnas su rdo rje'i mdzod gtong ba/ /sna tshogs sems dpa' sems can brlag gyur pa/ /sbyor ba gzhan min ma thogs bshad du gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod ni dbang mchog bgyid mdzad cing*// rdo rje pad+ma phye ba'i tshul du sbyor mdzad la/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gzugs kyi sku ni rab ston ste/ /bde ba thams cad sgrub pa nyid kyis mnyes mdzad gsol/ / zhes lan gsum bya/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ me tog bzung*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs/ rig ma stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ rdzogs par gyur/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ nas/ saṃ sngon po/ snying khar hūṃ nag po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/

spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te nas mchod par gyur/ dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu gyur pa sku'i dbyibs rgyud nor bu'i rtse mor lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas nas mthar mtheb srin gyis phyung la bum pa'i dung chos sam pad+ma'i snod du bzhag la/ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bde bskyed bde ba chen po ste/ /de yis deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog / ces sogs bkra shis gyi glu dang gong du bstan pa'i/ pad+ma'i dbus gnas rin chen zhes pa nas/ spyir dbab dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes lce thog tu bzhag myangs la a ho mahā su kha zhes brjod/ de nas 'bru gsum gyis mig dar bkrol la/ de ltar na/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam thig le gsum gyi rnal 'byor snang bcas rgyu lus dang bcas pa sgom pa la dbang*/ ngag gi dri ma 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku

zhes 'don pa spo/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal la phul/ dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal nyan thos de bzhin te/ /sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba na/ /phyag 'tshal na ni ma rung 'gyur/ /kun tu rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /lus ngag yid kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /bsam gtan rdo rje gsum sbyor bas/ /sngags bzlas pas ni bsam gtan bya/ /mdor na sems can khams rnams ni/ /bsam gtan rdo rjes bskur bar bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi phyag 'tshal mchog /dam tshig rdo rje las byung ba'o/ /mchod rten dag gi las mi bya/ / glegs bam bklag par mi bya zhing*/ /dkyil 'khor dag kyang yod mi bya/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya'o/ /rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang*/ /tshon rtsi dag ni dgye ba nyid/ /sngags kyi sems dpa' mi bya ste/ /byas na byang chub brnyes par dka'/ /gal te byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing ngo*/ /sngags rnams kun gyi dam tshig ni/ /rgyal ba kun kyang mi 'da' 'o/ / zhes dam tshig bsgrags pa la/ de ltar bgyi'o/ / zhes khas blangs/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/ /thams cad stong pa bla na med/ /mngon par byang chub mthong bar ni/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /las dang skye las rnam grol ba'i/ /tshe 'dir byang chub mchog thob pa/ /rang myong mtshan nyid gcig pa nyid/ /sems dpa' chen po stsol du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ de nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya gtad/ bzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /brten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /'khor lo'i rim pa sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung kyis sems ni/

/ nor bu'i nang du son lta bas/ / zhes brjod/ dri ba dri lan ched brjod kyang spyi dang mthun par byas kyang legs mod/ lag len bsdus pa'i skabs 'drir med kyang rung ngo*/ / bhañtsa mo k+ṣa ho/ zhes pang du byon/ rang dang rig ma gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka'ang maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid dpal ldan nas ldan par gyur/ rig ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ dharma nas/ rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin rdzogs par brjod/ khyad par bum pa'i chus dngos su dbang bskur/ yum gyi spyi gtsug zhes pa nas phaṭa kyis bkag par gyur gyis bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas yab yum phan tshun du blta zhing rjes su chags pa yang dag par bskyed/ sī ta shi shi shi ha ha ha/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bkug pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba bdag nyid rig mar bcas pa'i phyag rgya bzhi la dbang bskur tshul gyis thim par gyur/ rmongs la gti mug bdag nyid sbyor/ /gti mug dga' ma yang dag ldan/ /gti mug rgyun gyis dbang bskur na/ /gti mug rdo rje rang nyid 'gyur/ / de bzhin du sbyar te/ sdang la zhe sdang*/ zhe sdang dga' ma/ zhe sdang rgyun/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ chags la 'dod chags/ 'dod chags dga' ma/ 'dod chags rgyun/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ shes rab ye shes bdag nyid/ rdo rje dga'/ ye shes rgyun/ shes rab ye shes bdag nyid 'gyur/ dga' bzhi dang ye shes gsum gsal zhing brtan par gyur/ mig dar bkrol/ de ltar na/ phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba/ lam dbang gi ye shes dang 'od gsal bsgom pa/

yid ky-i dri ma 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku zhes 'don pa spo/ de nas tshig dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang*/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bcom ldan snying po bshad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ rdo rje 'chang ba chen po yi/ /sku ni blta bas mi ngoms shing*/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ltar snang ba/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rig mas 'khyud/ /shes rab ye shes dbang dus su'ang*/ /mtshan nyid dpe yi tshul du gnas/ /dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdong nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ / zhes sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa yin la/ 'bras bu'i mthar thug de nyid chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyang yin zhing*/ de nyid zab gsal gnyis su med pa dang yan lag bdun dang ro myang brgyad kyi bdag nyid do/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ khyod ky-is ma byin par yang long*/ /gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis/ /de ltar na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bzhi pa'i dbang*/ lam zung 'jug bsgom pa sgo gsum gyi dri ma 'bras bu sku gsung thugs mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid sku zhes 'don pa spo/ dbang dngos gzhi rnams bstan zin to/ /mtha' rten ni/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang*/ lung bstan dang*/ dbugs dbyung ngo*/ /dang po ni/ thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /de bas rig ma 'di ni mchog /gnyis su med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /gnyis kyi dngos po mtshon pa yin/ /de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar bral bar ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa// de la mchog gi dngos grub med/

/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kyai dpal nas/ a gang zhig de ltar lung bstan pa'i/ /sngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi gtso/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis lung bstan to/ / zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol ste/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /ston pa mchog tu khyod 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ / sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsung*/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ / rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos la smad mi bya// nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'i rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid rnam par bstan mi bya/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs btang ste/ /dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bar bde bzung na/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyus kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas/ /slob dpon la ni gang brnyas pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun brnyas pas/ / rtag tu sdug bsngal thob bar 'gyur/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang*/ / mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang*/ /bgegs dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/

/rdo rje slob dpon blo chen po/ /dge ba rab tu mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya/ /des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung*/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ / rtag tu bla ma la dbul bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de phyin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /gang phyir 'di la legs gnas pas/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /'gyur ba 'di la them tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis/ /de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur te/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ / bdag po nyid du khyod nges so/ /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer dam par rab tu zhugs/ /de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde ster bsten par gyis/ / 'gro ba bde ba myur la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur/ / zhes brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad dbang gis bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum gyis khas blangs*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de nas nus na zhi rgyas kyi sbyin bsreg gis kyang lha mnyes par byas la/ mthar dam tshig gsum gyi glu dang bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma mtha' ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/

/nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che/ /de nyid kyis ni bdag grub mdzod/ /shin tu rnam dag kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po'i rgyal mchog gis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ / sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ dam tshig mchog gyur 'dod pa mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ / bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /bden pa de yi mgon bdag la/ khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog / ces so/ / de nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni dbang chog chen mo las rtogs par 'gyur zhing*/ gal te cho ga mdor bsdus su dbang bskur na/ ngag 'don rnams gong bdag 'jug gi skabs ltar dang lag len mthong ba rgyud pa las shes so/ / lnga pa rjes kyi cho ga ni mchod pa bshams pa'am kha gsos/ sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ nang mchod 'bul rang gi yid dang mthun par gsol ba btab/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs lhag pa dang sogs/ bag med spyod pa sogs/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la/
